profile.name: m6000-32g
profile.title: Quadro M6000 24 GB with 32 GB of RAM
profile.tested: 2026-11-18 on a VM with 16 EPYC 7742 threads, 31 GiB of RAM and the M6000 at PCIe Gen3 x8: speed 40.1 / 43.9 / 31.2 / 40.0 tok/s (chat / code / story / 4K doc), prompts 199 tok/s; balanced 32.4 / 33.6 / 25.3 / 29.1 tok/s, prompts 170 tok/s; both in low-RAM mode, answer checks passed
notes: IQ3_S (quality) needs about 57 GiB of free RAM and is not offered.
The packs do not fit in RAM: the engine keeps the most used experts in RAM and reads the rest from disk (low-RAM mode), so a fast SSD matters.
Keep other programs light: with IQ3_XXS every GiB they take slows answers down; Q2_0 holds its speed.
A switch takes about 10 minutes: the packs do not stay in the page cache, so each start reads the pack from disk.

speed.description: Q2_0 pack, 2.4 bits/weight: the fastest, and the best choice with 32 GB of RAM; task average 89.1

balanced.description: IQ3_XXS pack, 3.0 bits/weight: task average 92.6; with 32 GB it slows down as other programs use RAM
